P.name: Relentless Assault
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Relentless Assault'' {{tip|on-attack}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.25}} seconds when the duration ends.
P.description2: {{sbc|Relentless Assault:}} For each stack, '''Jax''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|5 to 14 for 7|1 to 19}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|40 to 112 for 7|1 to 19}}|attack speed}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Grandmaster at Angling:}} While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, '''Jax''' will occasionally catch a fish, granting him {{g|1}} and {{as|1 ability power}} for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a [[File:Jax Grandmaster at Angling 2.png|link=|20 px]] rare fish that grants {{g|10}} and {{as|10 ability power}} for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Leap Strike
Q.description2: If the target is an enemy and they are in range <!--how many units? center or edge?--> upon arrival, '''Jax''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to them.
Q.description3: '''''Jax''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

W.name: Empower
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Leap Strike|Jax}}'' against an enemy within 10 seconds to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against {{tip|structures}}. If ''Empower'' is used on a basic attack, it will gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}.

E.name: Counter Strike
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' enters ''Evasion'' for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to {{tip|dodge}} all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all {{tip|area of effect}} {{tip|abilities}} sourced from {{tip|champions}}.

''Counter Strike'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jax''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with the '''total''' damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 160*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}

R.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' {{tip|on-hit}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against {{tip|structures}}. While ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' swings his lantern around, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased {{tip|size}} for 8 seconds.
R.description3: '''''Jax''' can move during Grandmaster-at-Arms' cast time.''
